name: property-filter
purpose: One field that filters a collection by properties and free text, after Cloudscape's property filter. Typing suggests a property, then an operator, then a value, and each choice becomes a removable token (`Status = Active`); text typed without a property becomes a free-text token. Two or more tokens combine with Match all (and) or Match any (or). With `mode="query"` the same field edits one query string instead (`level = Error AND method = GET`), after the Console Kit events query bar: suggestions follow the word at the caret (a field, an operator, a value, then AND or OR), a check explains what is wrong under the field, and Enter submits the text with its flat token list. Since spec v4, tokens mode also builds one level of nested conditions (`grouped`: each group has its own Match all / Match any, and the groups combine with the query's operation — `(Status = Active or Status = Paused) and (Region = US East or Region = EU West)`), fetches the values of a property as the person types (`loadValues`, with a loading and an error row and a count per value), groups the operator suggestions (Equality, Comparison, Text match), and hands the value of a property marked `customValue` to the `value` slot (a date picker, a number range). It edits a `PropertyFilterQuery` and never filters anything itself: `useCollection` (or the server) applies the query, and `propertyFilterProps` binds the query, the properties and the match count in one `v-bind`.
useWhen: Use PropertyFilter when people type queries with operators (Status = Active, Requests > 100) or free text they want to keep.
A list or table that people narrow by several fields at once (status, region, owner) and by text.
Any collection driven by `useCollection`, client or server mode.
Filters that must survive a reload or a shared link: the query serializes into the URL through `useCollection`.
With `mode="query"`: an explorer (events, logs) whose users type queries by hand, keep and reuse them as text, or need a grammar of the product (pass `validate` and `suggest`).
avoidWhen: A single text search over a short list → use `input` bound to `filterProps`.
A few fixed choices always on screen → use `toggle-group` or `chip` filters.
Inside a DataTable toolbar, `Table.Filter type="property"` renders this field wired to the table's filters; bind PropertyFilter to `useCollection` yourself only for OR queries or free text.

Faceted picks from a known set of values per field (status, region, owner), shown as chips → use `filter-menu`. PropertyFilter is for expression search: typed tokens, operators, free text and a query people keep as text.
related: `use-collection` — applies the query; `propertyFilterProps` is the binding.
`card-list` — the card form of a collection.
`collection-preferences` — the panel that sits beside it in the controls row.
bestPractices: Give every property with a closed set of values its `options`, so values are suggested and tokens print labels.
Set `type: 'number'` or `type: 'date'` on ordered properties to offer `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`.
Bind `totalCount` so people hear how many items match after each change.
Turn on `grouped` only when people need both and and or in one filter; most filters read better flat.
Use `loadValues` when a property has too many values to ship (hostnames, users); return at most a few dozen per call, already filtered by the typed text, with `count` when the server knows it.
Mark a property `customValue` when its value is easier to pick than to type (a date), and render the editor in the `value` slot; call `apply` with the value text.
Name the field after the collection (`aria-label="Filter resources"`).

In query mode, fields are written by `key` (no spaces); quote values that hold spaces or operator characters (`"edge cache"`). Apply the `query` of `submit` when it is not null; keep the `text` for saved and recent queries.

A product grammar (`like`, `between`, parentheses) passes `validate` and `suggest`; `submit` then carries `query: null` for text the built-in grammar cannot flatten, and the product parses `text` itself.

props.name: properties
props.doc: Properties the suggestions offer, with their operators and values.

props.name: totalCount
props.doc: Items that match the query, announced next to the tokens. Hidden when unset.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: freeText
props.doc: Accepts typed text with no property as a free-text token.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the field and the tokens.

props.name: mode
props.doc: `tokens` turns each choice into a token; `query` edits one query string.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Checks the query string in query mode: '' when valid, else the message shown under the field. Replaces the built-in check.

props.name: suggest
props.doc: Suggestions for the word at the caret in query mode. Replaces the built-in field, operator, value and AND / OR suggestions.

props.name: grouped
props.doc: Tokens mode: tokens go into groups with their own Match all / Match any; Add group starts the next one.

props.name: showOperations
props.doc: Shows the Match all / Match any toggle; false keeps the tokens combined with AND (a model that holds only AND conditions, such as a table's filters).

props.name: loadValues
props.doc: Fetches the values of a property for the typed text, after the operator. Replaces its `options` in the suggestions.

events.name: submit
events.notes: Enter with no active suggestion and a valid query; `event` is the Enter keydown. Query mode only.

slots.name: value
slots.scope: { property: FilteringProperty, operator: PropertyFilterOperator, apply: (value: string) => void }
slots.notes: Tokens mode. Rendered under the field, in a named `group`, once the typed text has a property marked `customValue` and an operator; `apply` adds the token and returns focus to the field.
